text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but include a one-click toggle to light mode. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light and match the competitive analysis’ preference for dark interfaces, improving liveliness and clarity. The trade-off is a slight increase in initial setup complexity to ensure the toggle works smoothly across all visual elements.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t setup complexity—it’s alienating users who *prefer* light mode by default, not just those who toggle. A persistent toggle still forces a choice that shouldn’t exist: why not let the system remember the user’s last theme selection instead? Settle it with A/B testing: track retention and satisfaction for both default-dark and system-preference approaches.
